name: Pure One Corporation Limited
summary: Pure One Corporation Limited, identified by the ASX ticker P1E.AX, dedicates itself to pioneering advancements in zero-emission transportation and developing natural gas energy projects across its operational territories of Australia and Botswana. The firm further diversifies its offerings by supplying various commercial vehicles, including refrigerated trucks, forklifts, and buses. Previously known as Pure Hydrogen Corporation Limited, the company adopted its current name, Pure One Corporation Limited, in December 2025. Its primary corporate office is located in Crows Nest, Australia.
